status: in progress; overall throughput and memory parity remain unmet
acceptance: Keep pursuing throughput and memory parity before accepting the pivot.
implementation: Remove the relay datagram scratch copy and retained mutex/Vec. Quinn packet construction borrows an owned Vec from a per-thread cache for the synchronous transmit turn. After successful UDP submission it returns that cleared allocation for another connection. A socket-blocked packet transfers exact ciphertext ownership back to its connection until writable retry. No protocol, queue-depth, credit, timer, congestion, crypto or fairness limits change. Nested/custom socket calls use independent owned buffers; Thread-local teardown does not panic.

formatting_update.scope: After the benchmark freeze, cargo fmt collapsed one multiline if-chain into one line. No tokens or behavior were intentionally changed. rustfmt --edition 2024 --config skip_children=true --emit stdout on the archived measured source reproduces the current source exactly. Original benchmark executable and pre-format source are retained; formatted release receives independent capacity/mixed/browser verification.

scope: Local Linux loopback. Frozen server/client binaries; three alternating fresh-process repetitions for WT comparisons. Reliable screen: four individually pinned server workers 0-3 and eight individually pinned client workers 8-15, four seconds, 1 KiB, 32 private pairs, 1024 room readers, fanout window four. Capacity: eight pinned server and eight pinned client workers, 100000 independently counted connections, four seconds of offered traffic, 400000 checked deliveries. WS controls use the final binary explicit legacy mode and same frozen verifiers, but were collected in a subsequent block, not interleaved with WT. No builds/tests/browser alongside authoritative timing runs. Logarithmic percentiles are upper bounds; gate-sampled server RSS excludes kernel socket resources.

copy_removal.finding: One scratch pass and persistent scratch ownership removed. Three-run echo measurements do not show a material throughput gain; copying is not established as the primary bottleneck. The downstream WebTransport framing allocation/copy remains.

rejected_inline_receive.finding: Opportunistically handles input under the endpoint while an idle connection lock is available, publishes app events immediately and wakes the regular driver for transmit/timer work. One-worker median rate rises about 5.9%; four-worker rate is essentially unchanged and CPU per completion rises about 3.6%. Rejected and fully reverted; no weak driver references, extra locks or alternate dispatch remain in product source.

diagnostics.capacity_exclusions: A diagnostic test compilation overlapped candidate repetition 3 setup. Preserve that successful receipt but exclude it from timings. Earlier capacity runs also used a pre-final-source-comment binary hash. Fresh repetitions 4-6 compare the exact frozen final candidate and baseline without concurrent builds/tests.

heap-direct-datagram.scope: 8194 real sessions, gperftools replacement allocator; excluded from ordinary timing and RSS medians. Three original phase gates retained. Logical retirement gauges and requested live allocations need not settle at the same instant.

heap-shared-transmit-final.scope: 8194 real sessions, gperftools replacement allocator; excluded from ordinary timing and RSS medians. Three original phase gates retained. Logical retirement gauges and requested live allocations need not settle at the same instant.

mixed_cpu_profiles.scope: Separate eight-second diagnostic captures, cycles:u at 499 Hz with DWARF stacks; excluded from ordinary medians. Sampling identifies work and does not establish the benefit of deleting one stage. Both runs pass the complete mixed-workload verifier.

validation.blocked_wire_scope: Real UDP socket wrapper forces WouldBlock then Pending, builds a second connection packet on the same current-thread runtime, resumes the first, verifies identical ciphertext and both received payloads, then waits for both endpoints to retire.

browser.scope: Actual delivered JS bundle in Chromium, nine checks including typed IDs/values, private/broadcast/datagrams, 128 KiB/5 MiB messages, variables, unsafe Number rejection, departure and real graceful closure.

formatted_build.scope: Final formatting collapses only a multiline if expression. Formatter-canonical source equality is checked against the archived measured source. The original repeated performance medians refer to the original frozen executable; the formatted executable is independently rebuilt and verified here, without pooling its one-off values into those medians.

datagram_echo_scope: Closed-loop diagnostic only, 32 sessions, one outstanding self-route echo each, 1 KiB, eight seconds, four server and four client workers. The direct fixed client remains the same for both server variants. Not saturation, fanout, network-loss or browser acceptance.
freshness_scope: One regression sample per mode/profile, not a statistical protocol ranking. 360 stamped 1 KiB states at 60 Hz over six seconds plus concurrent reliable 1 MiB bulk. Both directions on external port only in an isolated namespace. Loss is 20 ms one-way plus 2%; reorder also has 8 ms jitter and 25% reorder. Matching seed/parameters do not mean identical dropped packets. Missing updates are unreceived observations, not exclusively attributed to network loss. Stale datagrams cannot replace newer state.

kernel_resources.scope: Per-process CPU accounting includes user/system time. Full capacity receipts separately retain owned TCP socket census, UDP queues/drops and machine CPU snapshots. This is not a measurement of complete TCP/UDP kernel allocation bytes, and RSS comparisons exclude those allocations.

remaining: Overall throughput and memory parity remain unproven/unmet; this removes one measured storage cost, not the Quinn/application scheduling architecture. Datagram saturation/private/fanout/mixed receipt accounting remains separate from the echo/freshness diagnostics. Continue receive ownership/dispatch, active QUIC/HTTP3 storage and scheduling; full observer cancellation/re-subscribe, concurrent 100k/8192 inspection, broader overload/shutdown and QUIC buffer accounting remain required, along with final packaging/deployment docs. No push, release or deployment.
